blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-11 at Ethereum block 25730449 and Fraxtal block 39812404. Canonical Ethereum FRAX 0x853d955acef822db058eb8505911ed77f175b99e remained a direct non-proxy FRAXStablecoin deployment with no holder blacklist, freeze/thaw, pause, seize, or allowance-free arbitrary-burn selectors; current eth_call probes for isFrozen(address) and paused() reverted. pool_burn_from is onlyPools but delegates to allowance-checking ERC20Custom._burnFrom. Frax CrossChainCanonical-style FRAX deployments expose exchange, bridge-token, minter, and mint-cap controls but no holder blacklist/freeze/pause path. The former Fraxtal contract entry in the FRAX data was Wrapped Frax (WFRAX) at 0xfc00000000000000000000000000000000000002, a ProxyAdmin-upgradeable native gas-token wrapper treated in the review as sub-material for the legacy FRAX stablecoin rather than as the canonical L1 FRAX token; it is not a tracked FRAX route. The explicit freeze/freezeMany/thaw/pause surface is on frxUSD implementation 0x0000000048d2c8baf31742f6765383278bada4d5 behind proxy 0xcacd6fd266af91b8aed52accc382b4e165586e29; Blockscout log queries from the frxUSD start block through 25730449 returned no AccountFrozen or AccountThawed events. Legacy FRAX therefore remains Upstream through freezable reserve/frxUSD exposure, not Direct.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Legacy FRAX is Ethereum-native; its 13 tracked EVM CrossChainCanonical deployments are issuer-operated bridge representations administered by per-chain Frax Safes or, on ZKsync Era, an EOA. Controls and historical Multichain/FraxFerry ingress remain scored under Bridge Risk. Fraxtal WFRAX is a distinct gas-token wrapper and is not a tracked FRAX route. Peripheral non-EVM routes are preserved: NEAR via Rainbow Bridge lock-mint, Osmosis via Axelar, and Solana via Wormhole.
